proof_body:
by
  intro u c w R hu hc hw
  have hR : 0 < R := Metric.pos_of_mem_ball hw
  have h : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicContOnCl u (Metric.ball c R) := ⟨hu, by rwa [closure_ball c hR.ne']⟩
  have := h.circleAverage_poissonKernel_smul hw
  rw [← this]
  congr 1
  funext z
  simp [poissonKernel_def, Pi.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]
target_source: ∀ (u : ℂ → ℝ) (c w : ℂ) (R : ℝ), InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (Metric.ball c R) → ContinuousOn u (Metric.closedBall c R) → w ∈ Metric.ball c R → Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((‖z - c‖ ^ 2 - ‖w - c‖ ^ 2) / ‖z - w‖ ^ 2) * u z) c R = u w
